bool.note: true or false, in lower case.

number.note: A number; min, max, step and unit say what the loader or the converter checks, null where it says nothing.

list.note: A list of item_kind items written [a, b]; one_or_list says a lone item is also a list.

font.note: A font family name, or a list of names in the order of fallback.

path.note: A file or folder path; mode says open (a file that exists), save or folder. A path in a shell file is relative to that file.

icon.note: An icon name such as mdi:account; a prefix selects an icon set.

shadows.note: A block of Shadow blocks, the first on top, or a token reference (elevation.max).

tooltip.note: A Popup's Name, a short quoted text or an inline Tooltip block.

Transition.doc: The keys whose change animates, a key name or a list of them.

Duration.doc: How long a change of a Transition key takes, in milliseconds.

Easing.doc: The curve of the animation: STANDARD, EMPHASIZED or LINEAR.

Marquee.example: Marquee { Text: "A long title", Width: 120, Speed: 30 }

TextField.doc: An editable text field, single line or multi-line.

Name.doc: The unique name of this block in the shell: letters, digits and _, starting with a letter. Actions and Attach_To refer to it.

Part.doc: In a module's layout: names a part of the module that a stylesheet addresses as Module::part; unique in the module.

Class.doc: One style class name, or a list of them; the rules of those classes apply to the block.

Tooltip.doc: What opens when the pointer rests on the block: the Name of a Popup, a short text or an inline Tooltip block.

Key.doc: The name of an entry of a list in a module's layout; an entry of a For has its repeater's key unless it writes one.

Visible.doc: False hides the block from everyone, assistive technology included, and it takes no space.

Enabled.doc: False disables the block: it ignores input, takes the disabled style state and is announced as disabled.

Width.doc: The width: pixels, a percentage, AUTO (fit the content) or EXPAND (take the free space).

Height.doc: The height: pixels, a percentage, AUTO (fit the content) or EXPAND (take the free space).

Min_Width.doc: The least width the block may resolve to, in pixels or a percentage.

Min_Height.doc: The least height the block may resolve to, in pixels or a percentage.

Max_Width.doc: The greatest width the block may resolve to, in pixels or a percentage.

Max_Height.doc: The greatest height the block may resolve to, in pixels or a percentage.

Aspect_Ratio.doc: The width over the height, above 0; the other side follows from it.

Margin.doc: Transparent space around the block: one number or four (left, top, right, bottom).

Flex_Grow.doc: How much of the free space along the parent's flex axis the block takes, relative to its siblings.

Flex_Shrink.doc: How much the block gives up, relative to its siblings, when the parent is too small.

Align_Self.doc: Where this block sits across its parent's flex axis, replacing the parent's Align_Items.

Z_Index.doc: The paint order among siblings; a higher number paints later, on top.

Label.doc: The name assistive technology reads aloud for the field.

Tooltip_When_Disabled.doc: Lets a disabled block open its tooltip; without it a disabled block opens none.

A11y_Hidden.doc: Hides the block from assistive technology while it stays visible.

Opacity.doc: How opaque the block and what it holds is painted, from 0 (invisible) to 1.

Position.doc: RELATIVE lays the block out in its parent; ABSOLUTE takes it out of the layout and places it by Left, Top, Right and Bottom.

Left.doc: The inset of an absolute block from its parent's left side.

Top.doc: The inset of an absolute block from its parent's top side.

Right.doc: The inset of an absolute block from its parent's right side.

Bottom.doc: The inset of an absolute block from its parent's bottom side.

Translate_X.doc: Moves the painted block sideways without changing the layout.

Translate_Y.doc: Moves the painted block up or down without changing the layout.

Scale.doc: Scales the painted block around its centre; 1 is its own size.

Rotation.doc: Rotates the painted block, in degrees.

Clip_Children.doc: Clips the children to the block; the block's own paint is not clipped.

Role.doc: What assistive technology announces the block as.

Description.doc: A longer description for assistive technology; a text Tooltip is also the description.

Live.doc: Announces changes of the block: POLITE waits for a pause, ASSERTIVE interrupts.

Value.doc: The accessible value of a control, a number or a string; set by a module, not written in a shell file.

Value_Min.doc: The least value of a control, for assistive technology; set by a module.

Value_Max.doc: The greatest value of a control, for assistive technology; set by a module.

Value_Step.doc: The step of a control's value, for assistive technology; set by a module.

Checked.doc: Whether the block is checked, for a toggle or a checkbox; set by a module.

Selected.doc: Whether the block is the selected entry of a list; set by a module.

Expanded.doc: Whether the block's submenu or section is open; set by a module.

Toggles.doc: Makes a click flip Checked and raise On_Changed: the block acts as a toggle or a checkbox.

Selection_Mode.doc: SINGLE makes the block's children the entries of a list of which one is chosen; NONE is a plain block.

Chosen.doc: The Key of the chosen entry of a list.

Slides.doc: Makes the block a slider along its axis: HORIZONTAL or VERTICAL; NONE is a plain block.

Menu_Item.doc: Makes the block take the pointer as a menu item.

Opens.doc: The Name of the Popup this menu item opens as its submenu; empty opens nothing.

Padding.doc: Space between the content and the four sides: one number or four (left, top, right, bottom).

Text.doc: The value of the field; edits come out through On_Changed.

Placeholder.doc: The text shown while the field is empty.

Multiline.doc: Makes the field several lines; Enter then inserts a new line.

Selection.doc: The selected text as [start, end], in byte offsets.

Show_Whitespace.doc: Draws marks for spaces and tabs, for a code editor.

Wrap.doc: WORD or NONE for a multi-line field; has no effect on a single-line one.

Lines.doc: How many lines high a multi-line field is, 1 or more.

Read_Only.doc: The text can be selected and copied but not changed.

Max_Length.doc: The most characters the field takes; 0 is no limit.

Password.doc: Hides the characters as dots in a single-line field.

Transition.doc: The keys whose change animates, a key name or a list of them.

Duration.doc: How long a change of a Transition key takes, in milliseconds.

Easing.doc: The curve of the animation: STANDARD, EMPHASIZED or LINEAR.

Background.doc: The fill behind the block's content, a colour or a theme token.

Border_Width.doc: The width of the border line; 0 draws none.

Border_Color.doc: The colour of the border line, a colour or a theme token.

Corner_Radius.doc: The radius of the corners: one number, or four from the top-left corner clockwise.

Padding.doc: Space between the content and the four sides: one number or four (left, top, right, bottom).

Margin.doc: Transparent space around the block: one number or four (left, top, right, bottom).

Opacity.doc: How opaque the block and what it holds is painted, from 0 (invisible) to 1.

Elevation.doc: How high the block floats, as a percentage of the theme's largest shadow; 0% is no shadow.

Shadows.doc: A list of Shadow blocks, the first on top; it replaces Elevation when both are written.

Foreground.doc: The colour of the text or of the icon, a colour or a theme token.

Font_Family.doc: A font family name, or a list of them in the order of fallback.

Font_Size.doc: The size of the type, above 0.

Font_Weight.doc: The weight of the type as a whole number, 400 regular, 700 bold.

Overflow.doc: What a single-line field does with text that does not fit: SCROLL, ELLIPSIS or CLIP.

Placeholder_Foreground.doc: The colour of the placeholder text.

Main_Shell.doc: The shell file to start, looked up in the Shells directories.

Registry.doc: The registry file that remembers UIDs and positions; an absolute path.

Directories.doc: Extra folders to search for each kind of file.

Logging.doc: Where and how the shell logs.

Validation.doc: Whether files are validated at load.

Hot_Reload.doc: Applies a saved file to the running shell.

Reload_Debounce.doc: How long files must be quiet before a reload, in milliseconds.

Appearance.doc: The theme and the stylesheets in use.

Level.doc: The least severe message that is logged.

Directory.doc: The folder of the log files; the default is logs in the config directory.

Retention.doc: How many days of log files are kept; leaving it out keeps them all.

Format.doc: TEXT for lines a person reads, JSON for lines a program reads.

Diagnose.doc: Adds the values of variables to a logged traceback.

Capture_Stderr.doc: Routes the standard error stream into the log.

Enabled.doc: Whether files are checked against the schema at load.

Theme.doc: The Name of the theme to use; the shell's Default theme when left out.

Stylesheets.doc: The Name of a stylesheet or a list of them, lowest priority first.

Follow_Desktop.doc: Follows the desktop's colour scheme, accent, contrast and reduced-motion settings.

Panel_Hide.doc: How a Panel is hidden: KEEP leaves the surface mapped and draws nothing, CLOSE destroys the window.

Frame_Join.doc: How the join of a melded Panel animates: PARAM, SMIL, CONCAVE, SHADER or STRUCTURE. A restart applies it.

Frame_Blend.doc: How the Frame's ring is blended: LINEAR in linear light or SRGB. A restart applies it.

On_Open.doc: A Panel is about to show.

On_Close.doc: A Panel is about to hide.

On_Focus.doc: The block took keyboard focus. Not raised yet.

On_Unfocus.doc: The block lost keyboard focus. Not raised yet.

On_Click.doc: A click: the mouse, Space or Enter on a focused block, or assistive activation.

On_Changed.doc: A control's value changed by the user: a toggle flipped, an entry chosen, a slider moved; for each new value while the pointer moves. A TextField raises it for each change of its text.

On_Released.doc: A slider's press ended, once, with the final value.

On_Change.doc: Reserved: the old spelling of On_Changed.

On_Text_Commit.doc: Committed text in a TextField, such as an input-method composition.

actions.name: Show
actions.doc: Shows the Panel or strip named by Target; Data is given to a Popup as caller.data.

args.name: Target
args.doc: The Name of the Panel or strip.

args.name: Data
args.doc: Values the opened Popup reads as caller.data.

actions.name: Hide
actions.doc: Hides the Panel or strip named by Target.

args.name: Target
args.doc: The Name of the Panel or strip.

actions.name: Toggle
actions.doc: Shows the Panel or strip named by Target if it is hidden, else hides it.

args.name: Target
args.doc: The Name of the Panel or strip.

args.name: Data
args.doc: Values the opened Popup reads as caller.data.

actions.name: Close
actions.doc: Closes the Popup that holds the block.

actions.name: Call
actions.doc: Runs a module's @action: Target is Module.action, the other keys are its arguments.

surface.doc: The ground of bars and panels.

surface_raised.doc: A surface above the ground: popups, buttons, tooltips.

on_surface.doc: Text and icons on a surface.

on_surface_muted.doc: Secondary text and icons on a surface, and a disabled state.

primary.doc: The main colour of controls: a filled slider, a checked toggle.

on_primary.doc: Text and icons on the primary colour.

accent.doc: The accent colour; DESKTOP follows the desktop's accent.

error.doc: An error or a critical state.

warning.doc: A warning or a low state.

scrim.doc: The colour laid over what a modal surface covers.

caption.line_height.doc: The line height of caption type.

label.line_height.doc: The line height of label type.

body.line_height.doc: The line height of body type.

title.line_height.doc: The line height of title type.

display.line_height.doc: The line height of display type.

full.doc: Fully rounded: a pill or a circle.

step_3.doc: A step of spacing between small things.

step_4.doc: A step of spacing inside controls.

step_5.doc: A step of spacing between controls.

step_6.doc: A step of spacing between groups.

reach.doc: How far the largest shadow reaches, in pixels.

max.default: Max { Shadows { Shadow { Color: "#00000066", X: 0, Y: 16, Blur: 48, Spread: 0 } } }
max.doc: The shadow list at 100% elevation; a smaller Elevation scales it.

Badge.doc: A pill with a count, or a dot, in the error colour.

Count.doc: The number shown; 0 shows nothing unless Show_Zero is true.

Show_Zero.doc: Shows the badge for a count of 0.

Max.doc: The largest number shown; above it the badge reads that number and a plus.

Dot.doc: Shows a dot with no number.

Battery.doc: The battery's charge as an icon and a number, with a tooltip; hides without one.

show_percent.doc: Shows the charge as a number next to the icon.

Button.doc: A pressable control with an optional icon and text.

Icon.doc: An icon name such as mdi:home, or a file path, shown beside the text.

Icon_Position.doc: Where the icon sits: START (before the text) or END (after it).

Label.doc: The name assistive technology reads aloud; the text when it is empty.

Checkbox.doc: A box that is checked or not, with an optional text beside it.

Checked.doc: Whether the box is checked; set from outside.

Text.doc: A label beside the box; a click on it flips the checkbox too.

Label.doc: The name assistive technology reads aloud; the text when it is empty.

Clock.doc: The time, with a tooltip that shows the date.

format.doc: A strftime pattern; empty is chosen by hour_cycle.

locale.doc: A locale name such as de_DE for month and day names; empty is the process's own. The system must have it; a missing one is warned about and ignored.

timezone.doc: An IANA zone such as Europe/Berlin; empty is the local zone.

tooltip_format.doc: A strftime pattern for the text of the tooltip the pointer opens on the clock.

Expander.doc: A block that shows or hides its content with an animation.

Expanded.doc: Whether the content is shown; set from outside.

Direction.doc: The edge the content grows from: DOWN, UP, LEFT or RIGHT.

Duration.doc: The animation time in milliseconds; -1 takes the theme's.

Content_Fade.doc: Whether the content's opacity follows the animation.

Icon.doc: An icon from an icon set or a file, sized by one number.
An icon name such as mdi:account, or a file path relative to the file.

Size.doc: The width and the height, in pixels.

Image.doc: A picture from a file, with a placeholder while it loads.

Source.doc: The file to show, relative to the file that names it.

Fit.doc: How the picture fits its box: CONTAIN, COVER, FILL or NONE.

Placeholder.doc: A colour or an icon shown while the picture loads or fails.

Label.doc: A line of text in the theme's body type.

List.doc: A list of entries of which one can be chosen.

Selected.doc: The Key of the chosen entry, set from outside; empty is none.

Selection.doc: SINGLE lets one entry be chosen; NONE does not.

Label.doc: The name assistive technology reads aloud for the list.

Marquee_Text.doc: A line of text that scrolls when it is wider than its box.

Text.doc: The words; they scroll when wider than the box.

Speed.doc: How fast the text scrolls, in pixels a second.

Pause.doc: How long the text waits at each end, in milliseconds.

Direction.doc: The way the text moves: LEFT or RIGHT.

Loop.doc: RESTART jumps back to the start; BOUNCE scrolls back.

Media.doc: What a media player plays, with previous, play or pause and next buttons.

show_art.doc: Shows the artwork, 24 px (a file:// URL of the player's; a placeholder icon otherwise).

show_title.doc: Shows the title, scrolling when it is wider than max_width.

show_controls.doc: Shows the previous, play or pause and next buttons.

show_position.doc: Shows the seek slider; it turns on the one-second tick while the player plays.

actions.name: drag
actions.doc: The slider's handle moved by the user: nothing goes to the player until the release.

actions.name: release
actions.doc: The press on the slider ended (``On_Released``, ``position`` is its final value): ask the player for that position and wait for its ``Seeked`` (the module moves nothing itself). A press that moved nothing (a touch on the handle) seeks nowhere.

actions.name: seek
actions.doc: Ask the player to go to ``position`` seconds.

Menu.doc: The content of a Popup: a column of menu items.

Label.doc: The name assistive technology reads aloud for the menu.

MenuItem.doc: A row of a menu: text, an icon, a key hint, a rule or a submenu.

Icon.doc: An icon name or a file path shown before the text.

Shortcut_Text.doc: A key hint shown at the end of the row; display only.

Separator.doc: Makes the row a rule between groups; it takes no events.

Submenu.doc: The Name of the Popup that opens beside the row as its submenu; empty has none.

Label.doc: The name assistive technology reads aloud; the text when it is empty.

Network.doc: How the machine is connected, as NetworkManager reports it.

show_name.doc: Shows the connection's name (or the Wi-Fi network's) next to the icon.

show_vpn.doc: Shows a second icon while a VPN is up.

ProgressBar.doc: A bar that shows a value between a minimum and a maximum.

Value.doc: The progress, between Min and Max.

Min.doc: The value at which the bar is empty.

Max.doc: The value at which the bar is full.

Slider.doc: A control that sets a value between a minimum and a maximum by dragging.

Step.doc: The increment; a drag snaps to it.

Label.doc: The name assistive technology reads aloud for the slider.

TextBox.doc: Several lines of text that can wrap, be cut and be selected.

Wrap.doc: WORD wraps at word ends; NONE keeps the lines as written.

Max_Lines.doc: Cuts the text after this many lines; 0 is no limit.

Selectable.doc: Lets the user select the text.

Text.doc: The value, set from outside; edits come out through On_Changed.

Placeholder.doc: The text shown while the editor is empty.

Read_Only.doc: The text can be selected and copied but not changed.

Max_Length.doc: The most characters the editor takes; 0 is no limit.

Wrap.doc: WORD wraps at the width by word; NONE does not wrap and scrolls sideways.

Lines.doc: The height in lines, when the height is AUTO.

Text.doc: The value, set from outside; edits come out through On_Changed.

Placeholder.doc: The text shown while the field is empty.

Read_Only.doc: The text can be selected and copied but not changed.

Max_Length.doc: The most characters the field takes; 0 is no limit.

Password.doc: Shows dots instead of the text and blocks copy and cut.

Toggle.doc: A switch that is on or off.

Checked.doc: Whether the switch is on; set from outside.

Label.doc: The name assistive technology reads aloud for the switch.

Workspaces.doc: The virtual desktops as buttons: the current one is marked, a click switches.

label.doc: name shows each desktop's name (its number when it has none); number shows 1, 2, 3.

actions.name: switch
actions.doc: A click on a desktop's button: set KWin's ``current`` to its id. The call runs on the ``dbus`` thread; the mark moves when KWin's ``PropertiesChanged`` says so.
